type.name: Lunaris
type.doc: High-level memory-engine handle. Opens a storage backend by URL and drives ingest, recall, forget, and snapshot.

methods.name: open
methods.doc: Production constructor. Routes `url` through the scheme dispatcher to pick a StoragePort backend.

methods.name: ingest
methods.doc: Ingest one Episode through the hot path (graph-OFF default) or the graph-extraction path (toggle ON).

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Build a RetrievalBuilder bound to this handle's storage / keyword / embedder / clock.

methods.name: forget
methods.doc: Single-entry-point erasure API (OPS-01/02/03/04). Soft-delete default; hard mode requires a confirmation token.

methods.name: embedder_backend
methods.doc: Which embedder backend this process resolved: "llamacpp", "openai-remote", "ollama-remote", "noop", or "unresolved". A "noop" backend produces zero vectors, so recall silently degrades to keyword-only while still returning results.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.doc: Returns the current monotonic LSN — a cheap consistent snapshot marker. Implemented as no-op atomic_write(&[]).

type.name: Vector
type.doc: Vector-search DSL operator; root-level constructor for kNN retrieval.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct a Vector retriever over `index` with top-k fan-out.

type.name: Keyword
type.doc: Keyword / BM25 DSL operator; root-level constructor for lexical retrieval.

methods.name: bm25
methods.doc: Construct a BM25 keyword retriever over `index` with top-k fan-out.

type.name: Graph
type.doc: Graph-traversal DSL operator; anchors on a set of entity ids and expands N hops.

methods.name: anchored
methods.doc: Anchor on `entity_ids` and traverse up to `hops` edges out in the Lunaris graph.

type.name: RetrievalBuilder
type.doc: Chainable retrieval plan builder. Terminal .execute() runs the plan through the hydrate stage.

methods.name: and
methods.doc: Compose `other` in parallel with the current plan; unions the result set.

methods.name: fuse_rrf
methods.doc: Fuse two parallel branches via reciprocal-rank fusion (client-side or Moon-native depending on capabilities).

methods.name: top
methods.doc: Keep only the top `n` hits after fusion.

methods.name: filter
methods.doc: Attach a filter predicate (parsed via filter_str) to the query; fails on a malformed predicate string.

methods.name: as_of
methods.doc: Pin the query to an as-of-HLC time-travel view (SQL:2011 bi-temporal read).

type.name: GraphPipelineHandle
type.doc: Runtime toggle for the graph-extraction pipeline (default OFF per blueprint §5.2). The toggle method is the canonical single-item entry in the binding surface.

methods.name: toggle
methods.doc: Flip the pipeline ON or OFF. Idempotent. Emits `tracing::info!` only on real state transitions (D-12).

type.name: ConsolidatorPipelineHandle
type.doc: Runtime toggle for the ACT-R consolidator worker (default OFF per blueprint §5.1). Mirrors GraphPipelineHandle's single-item toggle surface.

methods.name: toggle
methods.doc: Flip the pipeline ON or OFF. Idempotent. Emits `tracing::info!` only on real state transitions (D-12).

type.name: ChatAgentMemory
type.doc: Conversational wrapper exposing a `remember` / `recall` pair over a per-user `MessageStream + WorkingMemory` pair.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct a ChatAgentMemory bound to `user_id`.

methods.name: remember
methods.doc: Record a single conversational turn.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall turns matching `query`.

type.name: MultiTurnConversation
type.doc: Cross-session conversational wrapper with a per-user scoped `.consolidate()` cross-session promotion pass.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct bound to `user_id`.

methods.name: remember
methods.doc: Record a turn for `thread_id` (session id).

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall turns matching `query` across all sessions.

methods.name: consolidate
methods.doc: Run one scope-filtered consolidation pass (Phase 9.1 cross-user isolation).

type.name: SlackArchive
type.doc: Slack archive wrapper. Holds a root MessageStream scoped at `slack:archive/`.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct a root archive handle.

methods.name: ingest_channel
methods.doc: Ingest one message into `channel` authored by `participant_id`.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall across the whole archive.

methods.name: channel
methods.doc: Narrow to one channel. Returns a SlackArchiveQuery.

methods.name: user
methods.doc: Narrow to one user. Returns a SlackArchiveQuery.

type.name: SlackArchiveQuery
type.doc: Narrowed query builder returned by SlackArchive::channel / SlackArchive::user.

methods.name: with_user
methods.doc: Add a `user` narrow on top of a `.channel(...)` narrow.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Execute the narrowed recall.

type.name: EmailThreading
type.doc: Thread-scoped email wrapper with an opt-in graph-pipeline builder.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct a new email-archive handle rooted at `email:thread/`.

methods.name: ingest
methods.doc: Ingest one email into `root_id`'s thread, authored by `from`.

methods.name: thread
methods.doc: Narrow to one thread `root_id`. Returns a new EmailThreading.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall across the current scope.

methods.name: with_graph_pipeline
methods.doc: Opt-in the v0.1.0 graph pipeline (blueprint §5.2 graph-default-off preserved when enable=false).

type.name: MeetingNotesMemory
type.doc: Meeting-notes wrapper with heading-scoped ingest and an opt-in graph-pipeline builder.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct bound to `meeting:notes/`.

methods.name: note
methods.doc: Record one note under `heading` (thread_id) with `body` content.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall across the meeting corpus.

methods.name: attendees
methods.doc: Narrow to notes attributed to `attendees`. Returns a MeetingNotesQuery.

methods.name: with_graph_pipeline
methods.doc: Opt-in the v0.1.0 graph pipeline (blueprint §5.2).

type.name: MeetingNotesQuery
type.doc: Narrowed query builder returned by MeetingNotesMemory::attendees.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Execute the narrowed recall (per-attendee Filter::Eq And).

type.name: DocumentKnowledgeBase
type.doc: Documentary knowledge-base wrapper. Owns a DocumentCorpus bound to a single `source_prefix`.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct a knowledge base bound to `source_prefix`.

methods.name: ingest
methods.doc: Ingest chunked `(content, metadata)` pairs.

methods.name: filter
methods.doc: Add an equality filter on a metadata field.

methods.name: top
methods.doc: Cap output at `k` hits.

methods.name: search
methods.doc: Execute the fused Vector + Keyword RRF recall.

type.name: ResearchPaperCorpus
type.doc: Research-paper corpus wrapper with opt-in citation graph.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct bound to `source_prefix`.

methods.name: with_graph_pipeline
methods.doc: Opt-in the citation graph (blueprint §5.2 graph-default-off).

methods.name: ingest
methods.doc: Ingest chunked `(content, metadata)` pairs.

methods.name: search
methods.doc: Execute the RRF-fused recall.

type.name: CodeRepoMemory
type.doc: Code-repository memory wrapper. Stores commit SHA in Episode metadata and recalls point-in-time function bodies.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct bound to `repo_prefix`.

methods.name: ingest_commit
methods.doc: Ingest one commit as a batch of `(function_body, metadata)` chunks.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall at point-in-time `as_of`.

type.name: TimelineReconstruction
type.doc: Timeline-reconstruction wrapper. Two-call composition of DocumentCorpus + TemporalQuery<Documents>.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct bound to `source_prefix`.

methods.name: ingest
methods.doc: Ingest timeline events as chunked `(content, metadata)` pairs.

methods.name: between
methods.doc: Recall all events in `[lo, hi)` — lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive (11-01 boundary semantics).

methods.name: as_of
methods.doc: Recall the snapshot at `ts`.

type.name: CustomerSupportHistory
type.doc: Customer-support history wrapper. Owns both a tickets DocumentCorpus and a chats MessageStream.

methods.name: new
methods.doc: Construct with hard-coded source prefixes `ticket:` and `chat:`.

methods.name: with_graph_pipeline
methods.doc: Opt-in the product/customer relationship graph (blueprint §5.2).

methods.name: ingest_ticket
methods.doc: Ingest one ticket body. `ticket_id` is stamped into metadata.

methods.name: ingest_chat
methods.doc: Ingest one chat-turn. `ticket_id/turn_idx` slug lands in the MessageStream thread_id.

methods.name: recall
methods.doc: Recall from both buckets; RRF fusion happens within each primitive's own bucket.
